question: How many bytes does a full green scripts/verify.ps1 run print to stdout, and which events account for them?
method: Ran the unmodified scripts/verify.ps1 (full scope, no -Stage) with an explicit -GodotPath and a short -TemporaryRoot outside the worktree (agent shell inherits neither GODOT4_CONSOLE nor a usable TMP/TEMP, per docs/engineering/ENVIRONMENT_SETUP.md), redirecting both stdout and stderr to one file so the capture matches exactly what an agent's context would receive from this command.
Counted total bytes with 'wc -c' on the captured file, matching the repository rule that a size claim names the command that produced it.

Parsed the same file with a short Python script: for every line, attributed it to the most recently seen '--- stage <name>:' marker (or 'preflight' before the first one), then classified the line as either a single-line JSON event (matched via '"event":"<name>"' and counted under that event name) or a non-JSON line (build/test/process narration). Summed UTF-8 byte length + 1 for the newline per line, then cross-checked the sum of all buckets against the independently measured file size (352330 vs 352331 - the 1-byte gap is the file's final line having no trailing newline, not a counting error).
The event and stage breakdown below is the direct output of that script; only the top-level 'command' fields were added by hand for reproducibility.
command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify.ps1 -GodotPath "C:/gamedev/Godot_v4.7.1-stable_mono_win64/Godot_v4.7.1-stable_mono_win64_console.exe" -TemporaryRoot "C:\gdftmp284" > baseline-full-run.log 2>&1 ; wc -c baseline-full-run.log
finding: 95.99% of stdout (338187 of 352330 bytes) is the raw per-line dump of Godot process output in the godot, ui and screenshots stages - Invoke-GodotChecked and Invoke-GodotExpectedFailure in scripts/GodotTools.ps1 pipe every line the engine prints straight to Write-Host. Almost all of that is a small number of single-line JSON events the engine itself emits (godot_headless_smoke alone is 192246 bytes across 16 invocations, ~12 KB each - the per-resolution HUD/UI dump the Issue describes). The remaining 4% is dotnet restore/build/test output and PowerShell test-script narration that scripts/verify.ps1's own Invoke-Checked lets pass through uncaptured, plus progress Write-Host lines inside the stage bodies themselves.
attributionOfNonJsonBytes: scripts stage (973 of 5687 bytes; the rest is the JSON test-result events listed above, one per dependency-free guard script Invoke-Checked runs) - blank lines and stage separators.
build stage (3189 bytes) - 'dotnet restore'/'dotnet build' console text, currently passed through because Invoke-Checked in scripts/verify.ps1 runs '& $FilePath @Arguments' without capturing output.
tests stage (2031 bytes) - 'dotnet test' console text for the same reason.
godot/ui/screenshots stages - progress narration ('Write-Host "Running Godot headless smoke..."' and similar) directly inside the stage bodies in scripts/verify.ps1.
targetForFix: verification_result must stay on stdout with every checksum; per-stage 'verification_stage' ok/elapsedSeconds lines must stay; everything else identified above is a candidate to move into the run's log file, which is most of the 352330 bytes measured here.
